name: Instituto Superior Técnico
summary: ULisboa's engineering school; of its 18 bachelor's, one is taught in English: a flexible General Engineering degree, via the national contest.

ib.text: EU citizens apply through the national contest: IB final grade 50%, IB exams replacing entrance exams 50%. Each exam at least 100 of 200, overall at least 120 (2026 criteria).

programmes.name: General Engineering (GENI)
programmes.about: Maths, physics, chemistry and biology with computational thinking and projects, then a pathway you shape yourself: close to one of Técnico's degrees, emerging technologies, or custom. Taught in English (180 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL for Mathematics A, and IB Physics for Physics and Chemistry (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).

needs.note: Replaces Mathematics A (CNAES table 2026); at least 100 of 200
Replaces Physics and Chemistry for engineering degrees (CNAES 2026); at least 100 of 200

programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade, 50% the two entrance exams; at least 120 of 200 overall. 2026 criteria.

notes: General Engineering has no published cut-off yet: Técnico and DGES show no last-placed grade for it.
EU/EEA citizens cannot use Técnico's international-student calls, which are for non-EU nationals.
Técnico's other 17 bachelor's are not described as taught in English on their own pages.
